text:
sam: Quick heads up — saw a ~$18k bump in last month's Asia GPU invoice. Line items show committed usage but many GPUs are untagged `cost_center=unknown`. Anyone digging?

maya: yikes. can you paste the invoice link?

sam: https://billing.cloudprovider.com/invoice/2026-02 line items 45-68. I ran quick BigQuery: `SELECT project, resource_labels FROM billing_export WHERE region='asia-east1' AND resource='nvidia-t4' AND cost>1000` — lots missing `team` or `cost_center` labels.

raj: We've had a few clusters reprovisioned by autoscaler in that region, autoscaler creates instances without labels when launched from instance-template v2.0. I'll check the template and terraform.

stella: FYI Finance popped a chargeback ticket. They're asking for attribution per team by EOD. :sweat_smile:

maya: Quick mitigation — can we run a tagging sweep to apply `cost_center=infra` for any instances launched by service-account `redwood-autoscaler@prod`? Then reexport billing and backfill.
Command (example): `gcloud compute instances add-labels --labels=cost_center=infra --filter='metadata.items.key:service-account AND zone:(asia-east1-*)'`

raj: That should work for current VMs but not for prior month. For historical we can use billing_export join with instance metadata and operation_id to attribute to projects, then map projects -> teams. I'll draft an Athena/BQ query to backfill cost allocation.

ops-bot: Reminder: billing export updated 2026-03-01 03:12Z — new labels column added.

finance-bot: Finance: please attach CSV with project->team mapping to ticket #FIN-4123. We'll reallocate charges after analysis.

sam: I'll own the BQ query and re-run distribution after tag-sweep. maya — can you run the label sweep now? tagging might reduce future drift. will post results here.
